setting.local_transitions.title: Fix local transitions (doors, cave entrances...)
setting.global_transitions.title: Fix global transitions (zone loading screens)
setting.diagnostic_log.title: Write a diagnostic report to the mod log at each transition (for bug reports)
formation.title: Formation (optional)
setting.minion_formation.title: Summons and raised creatures take a place in the formation
setting.minion_formation.help: Off: they trail behind their master, as in the base game. On: melee creatures walk ahead of the party and the others behind it.
setting.minion_speed.title: Slow summons keep up with their master
setting.minion_speed.help: A summon slower than its master moves at its master's speed while it follows. Raised creatures already do this in the base game.
tuning.summons.title: Summons
tuning.summons.corridor_width: Width of the free lane in the middle
tuning.summons.repath_distance: Distance before a summon moves again
tuning.raised.title: Raised creatures
tuning.raised.corridor_width: Width of the free lane in the middle
setting.party_formation.title: Smarter automatic formation for the party
setting.party_formation.help: Only when the party uses the automatic formation of the game. Four lines: tanks, melee fighters, support, ranged. This moves your companions inside the formation; nothing is written to the save.
tuning.party.front_gap: Gap between tanks and melee fighters
tuning.party.mid_gap: Gap between melee fighters and support
setting.creature_list_shortcut.title: Shortcut that opens the list of raised creatures
setting.creature_list_shortcut.waiting: Press the new shortcut (click again to cancel)
creature_list.title: Raised creatures
creature_list.help: Choose who comes with you. A creature that stays waits in this area: come back here to take it with you again.
creature_list.empty: No raised creature in this area.
creature_list.unavailable: This list is turned off because the mod could not follow the saves of the game. Every raised creature follows you, as before.
